chunks: 1125 - And Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān narrated from him that he said:
"Whoever prays with them in the first row is like one who prayed behind the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in the first row."

key_terms.الصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ: the first row of the congregation
key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, in prayer formation behind the leader
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَعَهُمْ: with them; in their company during congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying with them in the first row according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages praying with them in the front row and describes a great spiritual reward for doing so. It likens such participation to praying behind the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in the first row, showing the virtue and importance of this act.
